name: Bq76972 → Program I2C Address
description: Writes a new I²C address into the chip's data memory and switches to it. The address is held in the chip's RAM: it survives a reboot of the ESP but reverts to the default when the chip loses power, so `address` in the configuration must match whichever address the chip currently answers to. After an ESP-only reboot the chip still answers at the programmed address and setup at the configured one fails; either power-cycle the chip or set `address` to the programmed value. A permanent change needs the address programmed into the chip's OTP memory with the manufacturer's tools.
